description: This Java source file defines the RomChecksum class, which provides static methods for calculating and validating checksums within a byte array representing ROM data. The class is intended for use in the context of ROM tuning and reflashing, specifically for automotive ECU modifications, as part of the RomRaider project.

classes.name: RomChecksum
classes.description: A utility class for calculating and validating checksums within ROM byte arrays, primarily used for ensuring data integrity during reflashing operations.

methods.name: calculateRomChecksum
methods.description: Calculates checksums over specified regions of the input byte array and updates the checksum bytes in the array.

methods.name: validateRomChecksum
methods.description: Validates checksums embedded in the byte array within specified regions, returning the index of the first invalid checksum or 0 if all are valid.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Computes the checksum for a specified start and end address range and compares with the expected value.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Computes the checksum for a range of bytes, returning the checksum value as a 4-byte array.
